inputs.text:
Folks, we are watching the total unraveling of our constitutional order and basic human decency right before our eyes. Earlier this month, an Indiana judge—specifically Judge Christina R.—blocked a vital prolife law under the absurd pretext that limiting abortion supposedly violates freedom of religion. 

Let’s call this what it is: an absolute disgrace to our legal system and our foundational values. This assault on traditional morality and the sanctity of life was brought forward by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, who had the audacity to claim that protecting unborn children “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” 

When secular progressive organizations and fringe groups weaponize the courts to enshrine abortion as a sacred religious rite, they are spitting in the face of natural law, family values, and the millions of Americans who believe in basic human decency and the right to life. This is the bitter fruit of activist judges completely subverting the rule of law to advance a radical culture of death, prioritizing progressive judicial activism over the preservation of innocent life and our enduring moral heritage.
